mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with stronger economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for new homes, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a shift in economic composition towards more productive sectors, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases > 1% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
